tools.description: Generate a social media post caption, hashtags, and metadata using AI. Same as POST /api/ai/generate-post → tasks.ai.gemini_sync.
Analyze a social comment (sentiment, topics, urgency) and propose on-brand reply options. Same as POST /api/social/comments/analyze.
Generate a video script and video_prompt from generate_social_post output.
Generate an image_prompt from generate_social_post output (post image or video thumbnail).
Generate a marketing image from a text prompt. Same as POST /api/ai/generate-image → tasks.ai.gemini_sync.
Generate a short marketing video (OpenAI Sora or Gemini Veo per workspace AI settings).
Save caption with image (image post) or video + optional thumbnail (video post). Same as POST /api/posts → tasks.social.create_draft_post.
Schedule an existing draft post and attach target page(s). Same as POST /api/posts/:id/schedule → tasks.social.schedule_post. Requires account_ids (or platform to auto-pick a connected page).
Publish an existing draft or scheduled post immediately. Same as POST /api/posts/:id/publish → tasks.social.publish_post. Requires account_ids (or platform to auto-pick a connected page).
Publish a Mongo ads_campaigns draft (Meta: meta_publish_campaign; Google: google_create_campaign). Requires campaign_id only.

Refresh and return social account metrics for one connected account (Facebook, Instagram, or Twitter). Syncs followers/insights into the DB when possible and returns followers_count, recent metrics/insights totals, name, and username for answering Q&A (how many followers, what data do we have, engagement). Requires account_id from social_accounts. Prefer this over ads report tools for organic social page/account questions.

List Meta ad accounts (Graph GET /{user_id}/adaccounts). Requires account_id; optional user_id (default me), limit. Returns accounts (picker rows) and data (full rows with amount_spent/balance normalized from cents).
Get Meta ad account details (Graph GET /act_*). Requires account_id + ad_account_id; optional fields. Includes DSA flags for EU business_country_code.

Search Meta Ads Library (Graph GET /ads_archive). Requires account_id, search_terms, ad_reached_countries (array or comma-separated). Optional ad_type, limit, fields. Disabled when META_ADS_DISABLE_ADS_LIBRARY is set.

List campaigns for a Meta ad account (Graph GET /act_*/campaigns). Requires account_id + ad_account_id; optional status_filter (effective_status), objective_filter (string or list), limit, after cursor.
Get one Meta campaign by Graph id (fields: budget, bid_strategy, special_ad_categories, etc.). Requires campaign_id.
List Meta ad sets for a campaign (campaign_id) or ad account (ad_account_id). Same Graph call as reference get_adsets. Used by agents, POST /ads/tools/execute, and GET /ads/meta/ad-sets.
Get one Meta ad set by Graph id (budgets, targeting, bid fields, frequency_control_specs, etc.). Requires adset_id.
Update an existing Meta campaign (name, status, budgets, bid_strategy, objective, special_ad_categories, use_adset_level_budgets). Requires campaign_id.
Update an existing Meta ad set (name, status, budgets, bid_strategy, bid_amount, bid_constraints, targeting, frequency caps, DSA fields, etc.). Requires adset_id.
Create a paused Meta campaign (ODAX objective OUTCOME_*). ABO: use use_adset_level_budgets and set budget on ad set. Requires account_id, name, objective.

Create a paused Meta ad set. Requires platform campaign_id, objective (or campaign_objective), optimization_goal, billing_event, daily budget. Optional: bid_amount, bid_constraints, promoted_object, frequency_control_specs, use_resolve_targeting (default true for wizard targeting). For OUTCOME_TRAFFIC + website ads set destination_type WEBSITE (auto when link_url present).

Full Meta publish chain: campaign → ad set → creative → ad. Payload: account_id, name, objective, budget, targeting (adset_name, optimization_goal, billing_event), creatives (page_id, link_url). Same as publish_campaign task for Mongo drafts.
List Google Ads customer accounts accessible with connected credentials. Requires account_id (resolved to google_ads_client_config).
Get Google Ads customer profile (timezone, currency, status). Requires account_id. Use before campaign create to confirm customer context (meta_get_account parity).
Get one Google Ads campaign by platform_campaign_id. Requires account_id, platform_campaign_id.
List Google ad groups; optional platform_campaign_id filter. Requires account_id (meta_list_adsets parity).
Full Google publish chain routed by type (search|display|video|shopping|performance_max|app|local). Same payload as google_create_campaign.
Full Search publish: budget → campaign → ad group → keywords → RSA (+ geo when provided).
Full Display publish: budget → campaign → ad group → responsive display ad (+ geo).
Full Video publish: budget → campaign → ad group → YouTube video ad (+ geo).
Full Shopping publish: budget → campaign → ad group → all-products listing group. Requires merchant_id.
Full Performance Max publish: budget → campaign → asset group → linked assets (+ geo).
Full App publish: budget → MULTI_CHANNEL app campaign → ad group → app ad (+ geo). Requires app_id.
Full Local publish: budget → local campaign → ad group → local ad (+ geo).
Search geo target constants by name (Morocco, United States, etc.). Returns geo_target_constant_id list.
Resolve natural-language include/exclude geo intent to Google geo_target_constant IDs.
Expand seed keywords and/or landing page URL via Google Keyword Plan ideas (search volume, competition). Requires geo_target_constant_ids.
LLM seed keywords + Google Keyword Planner expansion + validation for Search campaigns. Requires prompt/topic; optional account_id + geo for Planner metrics.
LLM-generated Google RSA headlines and descriptions from campaign context.
Keyword ideas with optional search volume (LLM + Keyword Planner). Same as POST /api/ads/keywords/suggest.
LLM: determine if the user's offer is clear enough to auto-generate Search keywords and ad copy.
One-shot Search marketing: keywords + RSA headlines/descriptions (LLM + Planner).
Add language targeting to a campaign. languages or language_ids required.
List linked Merchant Center accounts (Shopping / retail PMax).
Pause a Google Ads campaign (reference pause_campaign). Requires account_id, platform_campaign_id.
Resume a paused Google Ads campaign (reference resume_campaign).
Permanently remove a Google Ads campaign (reference delete_campaign).
Copy a campaign with a new name and budget (reference copy_campaign).
List campaign budgets (reference list_budgets).
Update budget amount or name (reference update_budget).
Create sitelink extensions on a campaign. sitelinks: [{text, url, description1?, description2?}].
Create callout extensions on a campaign. callouts: string[].
Full Google publish chain routed by payload type (search|display|video|shopping|performance_max|app|local). Requires account_id, name, type.
List Google Ads campaigns for the connected customer (sync read). Requires account_id.
Create a Google Ads campaign budget (reference create_campaign_budget). Requires account_id, name, amount_micros or daily_budget.
Create a Google Search campaign with TargetSpend bidding. Requires account_id, name, budget_resource_name.
Create campaign on existing budget — SEARCH, DISPLAY, VIDEO, SHOPPING, PERFORMANCE_MAX, SMART, LOCAL.
Reference create_campaign — creates budget + typed campaign in one step.
Update Google Ads campaign status (ENABLED, PAUSED, REMOVED). Requires account_id, platform_campaign_id, status.
Update Google campaign geo targeting mode (presence vs interest). Requires campaign_resource_name or platform_campaign_id.
Add location targeting to a Google campaign. geo_target_constant_ids e.g. 2840 (US), 2124 (Canada).
Exclude locations from a Google campaign (negative geo). Requires geo_target_constant_ids.
Add broad negative keywords at Google campaign level.
Remove a Google campaign criterion (geo, keyword, etc.) by campaign_id and criterion_id.
List Meta ads for campaign_id, adset_id, or ad account. Same Graph call as reference get_ads. Used by agents and GET /ads/meta/ads.
Get one Meta ad by Graph id (creative, status, preview link). Requires ad_id.
Get one Meta ad creative by Graph id. Requires creative_id.
List creatives attached to a Meta ad. Requires ad_id.
Update a Meta ad (name, status, bid_amount, creative_id). Requires ad_id.
Update a Meta creative (name, optimization / asset_feed_spec fields). Requires creative_id.
Upload an image to the ad account; returns image_hash for create_ad_creative. Requires ad_account_id and media_id (library), file, or public HTTPS image_url.
Upload a video to the ad account; returns video_id for create_ad_creative (ThruPlay / video ads). Requires ad_account_id and video_url or file.
Compute image_crops coordinates for a source image size (reference compute_image_crops). No Graph call. Pass result to meta_create_creative.
List Facebook Pages usable with a Meta ad account. Requires account_id.

List Meta pixels on an ad account (Graph GET /act_*/adspixels). Requires account_id + ad_account_id. Returns pixels picker rows, data, and default_pixel_id when exactly one available pixel exists (auto-select for Sales conversion ad sets).
Get Meta pixel details (Graph GET /{pixel_id}). Requires pixel_id. Returns pixel row with name, matching settings, and availability. Use in campaign flows to verify pixel_id before ad sets.

Admin/setup only: create a Meta pixel (Graph POST /act_*/adspixels). Not for agent campaign workflows — use Events Manager or this tool via POST /api/ads/tools/execute. Requires account_id, ad_account_id, name.
Admin/setup only: update a Meta pixel (Graph POST /{pixel_id}). Not for agent campaign workflows. Requires pixel_id and at least one update field. Meta does not support deleting pixels via API.
Search Facebook Pages by name for a Meta ad account. Requires account_id; optional search_term.
Resolve viewable image URLs for a Meta ad creative. Requires ad_id.
Get video source URL and metadata for a Meta ad or video_id. Requires ad_id or video_id.

Create a Meta ad creative (full reference create_ad_creative: link/image/video/FLEX/placement/existing-post modes). Requires ad_account_id; page_id auto-discovered if omitted. link_url required unless object_story_id, lead_gen_form_id, or reminder_data.
Create a Meta ad using an existing creative_id and adset_id (reference create_ad).
Search Meta ad interest targeting by keyword (reference search_interests). Requires query.
LLM-generated Meta ad primary text, headline, and link description from campaign context.
LLM-generated geo + interest search queries for meta_search_geo_locations / meta_search_interests.
Get Meta interest suggestions from existing interest names (reference get_interest_suggestions).
Estimate audience size for targeting (reference estimate_audience_size). Requires ad_account_id + targeting, or interest_list for legacy validation.
List Meta behavior targeting categories (reference search_behaviors).
List Meta demographic targeting categories (reference search_demographics). Optional demographic_class.
Search Meta geographic targeting locations (reference search_geo_locations). Requires query.
Resolve natural-language include/exclude geo intent to Meta location keys.
Create a high-demand budget schedule on a campaign (reference create_budget_schedule). Requires campaign_id, budget_value, budget_value_type, time_start, time_end.
Duplicate a Meta campaign via Pipeboard API (reference duplicate_campaign). Requires META_ADS_ENABLE_DUPLICATION=1 and PIPEBOARD_API_TOKEN.
Duplicate a Meta ad set (reference duplicate_adset). Requires META_ADS_ENABLE_DUPLICATION=1.
Duplicate a Meta ad (reference duplicate_ad). Requires META_ADS_ENABLE_DUPLICATION=1.
Duplicate a Meta creative (reference duplicate_creative). Requires META_ADS_ENABLE_DUPLICATION=1.
Create a paused Google ad group under an existing campaign. Requires customer_id, platform_campaign_id, name.
Update Google ad group status (ENABLED or PAUSED). Requires ad_group_resource_name or platform_ad_set_id.
Add broad/phrase/exact keywords to a Google ad group.
Create a paused Google responsive search ad in an existing ad group.

Meta Ads performance insights (reference get_insights). object_id or alias account_id/campaign_id/adset_id/ad_id; time_range preset or {since,until}; breakdown, level, action_attribution_windows, action_breakdowns, compact, pagination after.
Google Ads campaign performance for a date range. Requires account_id; optional campaign_id.
List Google ad groups with optional campaign filter. Requires account_id.
Google keyword performance report. Requires account_id; optional campaign_id, ad_group_id.
Google ad-level performance report. Requires account_id.
Google search terms report. Requires account_id.
Google Ads account-level summary for a date range. Requires account_id.
Run a read-only GAQL query against Google Ads. Requires account_id and query string.
Read-only Google Ads optimization suggestions from campaign performance (no mutations). Requires account_id.
Read GAQL guide markdown from reference context (agent helper, no API call).
Read Google Ads reporting view docs (all views or one view name). Optional payload.view.
GAQL field metadata for a list of fields (reference get_reporting_fields_doc). Payload: fields array or comma-separated string.
MCC / customer_client hierarchy (reference get_account_hierarchy).
Get one ad group by id (reference get_ad_group).
Update ad group name, status, cpc_bid_micros (reference update_ad_group).
List keyword criteria (reference list_keywords).
Update keyword CPC bid (reference update_keyword_bid).
Pause keyword criterion.
Enable keyword criterion.
Remove keyword criterion.
List ads with filters (reference list_ads).
Pause ad (reference pause_ad).
Enable ad.
Remove ad.
Structured snippet assets on campaign.
Call asset on campaign.
List campaign assets / extensions.
Remove campaign asset by resource_name.
Upload image asset (base64).
Create text asset.
List customer assets.
Create a landing page, generate AI marketing copy, optionally publish for lead capture. Same as POST /api/ads/landing-pages/workflow.
Suggest negatives from costly search terms.
Geo performance report.
Device segment performance.
List portfolio bidding strategies.
Google Ads recommendations feed.
Apply one recommendation by resource_name.
Change status history (reference get_change_history).
Dayparting ad schedules on a campaign (reference create_ad_schedule).
Legacy expanded text ad (deprecated; prefer RSA google_create_ad).
Create remarketing / customer match user list (reference create_custom_audience).
Attach audience to ad group (requires audience_id from create or list).
List user lists / audiences for targeting.
Device and location bid modifiers on campaign.
Geo performance analysis with bid/exclude recommendations.
Scrape competitor pages + Meta Ads Library + AI brief. Same as POST /api/ads/competitive-analysis.
Cluster seed keywords by search intent using AI. Same as POST /api/seo/keywords/cluster.
Check SERP ranks for workspace keyword targets. Same as POST /api/seo/keywords/check-ranks.
Rules-based SEO audit on workspace landing pages. Same as GET /api/seo/landing-pages/audit.
Generate RSA headlines and descriptions for a Mongo campaign draft. Same as POST /api/ads/campaigns/:id/generate-assets. Requires campaign_id and campaign_name.
Analyze campaign KPIs and produce optimization suggestions (pacing + bids). Same as POST /api/ads/campaigns/:id/optimize. Requires campaign_id.
Workspace budget pacing analysis vs monthly targets. Same as POST /api/ads/budget/pacing.
Recommend budget shifts between campaigns by performance. Same as POST /api/ads/budget/reallocation.
CPA/ROAS bid recommendations at campaign and keyword level. Same as POST /api/ads/optimization/bid.
Quality Score monitoring and keyword recommendations. Same as GET /api/ads/optimization/quality-score.
Compare ad variants within ad groups for A/B winners. Same as POST /api/ads/optimization/asset-ab.
